name: NameHero Hosting
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-01

# Summary
NameHero is the shared hosting account that runs tagmktg.com, several WordPress sites and the static-HTML Prestige Plumbing site. Claude connects with the `namehero` SSH alias.

# Access (references only)
- `ssh namehero` = user `scottvin` on node614.namehero.net, port 37980. It connects as the cPanel owner, not Kim's team login.
- WP-CLI on the server at `~/bin/wp`.
- The agency handoff says the account holds about 25 domains; the WordPress engineer agent notes tagmktg.com plus 5 WordPress sites.
- Prestige docroot: `/home5/scottvin/prestigeplumbingsc.com/` (hand-built static HTML, not WordPress).

# Status and pending
- **Disk quota full (17 GB) since Jul 31, 2026**, so writes fail. Prestige deploys (blog rollout, hub content) are blocked until Scott frees space; a note to Scott was drafted but not sent.
- Security: change the password that was pasted in the Jun 12 NameHero SSH chat, if not already done.
